brief:
India lodged a complaint against Palestinian footballer Taha Soueidan following an under-17 match between the two countries, Al Jazeera English reported. The accusation centers on a gesture Soueidan allegedly made during the game, which Indian officials characterized as racist.

Soueidan said he was "deeply surprised" by the criticism and the complaint filed against him. The Palestinian player has not elaborated on the specific nature of the gesture or his account of what occurred during the match.
dek: Palestinian player Taha Soueidan 'deeply surprised' by criticism following accusations that he made a racist gesture.
title: India files complaint against Palestinian player over under-17 match gesture
